description.zh: 任务的ID列表，可根据任务Id批量查询任务。

description.en: The name of the task. Fuzzy match is supported.
The account ID of the task owner.
The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页的条目数，默认为10，最大为1000。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

The workspace environment.

Valid values:

- Prod

- Dev

description.zh: 资源组信息，这里请填入调度资源组标识符。
description.en: The information about the resource group. Set this parameter to the ID of a resource group for scheduling.

description.zh:
排序字段。支持修改时间、创建时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：

- `ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)`
- `CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`
- `Id (Desc/Asc)`

  默认值：`Id Desc`
description.en:
The field that is used to sort tasks. This parameter is configured in the format of "Sorting field Sorting order". You can set the sorting order to Desc or Asc. If you do not specify the sorting order, Asc is used by default. Valid values:

- `ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`

- `Id (Desc/Asc)`

  Default value: `Id Desc`.

description.zh: 触发时的运行模式，TriggerType=Scheduler时生效。
description.en:
The run mode when triggered. Valid only if TriggerType is Scheduler.

Valid values:

- Pause

- Skip

- Normal

The trigger type.

Valid values:

- Scheduler: Triggered by schedule.

- Manual: Triggered manually.
The ID of the workflow to which the task belongs.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: DataWorks Basic Edition or higher is required.
